prompt: Name an animal in the Chinese zodiac.
label: Easy Opener
source: The twelve-animal cycle of the Chinese zodiac (shengxiao).
valueLogic: Dragon and tiger are produced first by almost everyone. The middle band is the familiar domestic animals. Ox and goat form the tail - both are regularly forgotten, and the goat is further muddled by the goat/sheep translation.
note: Goat takes sheep and ram, Rat takes mouse, Ox takes cow/bull/buffalo: each Chinese character covers both animals, so these are translations, not leniency. Cat is a non-busting distractor because the Vietnamese zodiac has it in the rabbit's place.

answers.name: Dragon
answers.fact: The only mythical animal of the twelve, and the most sought-after birth year.

answers.name: Tiger
answers.fact: Third in the cycle, and a symbol of courage rather than danger.

answers.name: Horse
answers.fact: Seventh, and the midpoint of the twelve-year cycle.

answers.name: Snake
answers.fact: Sixth, and in Chinese tradition a sign of wisdom rather than treachery.

answers.name: Monkey
answers.fact: Ninth, and associated with cleverness and mischief alike.

answers.name: Dog
answers.fact: Eleventh, and the sign of loyalty.

answers.name: Rat
answers.fact: First in the cycle. The story goes that it rode the ox across the river and jumped off to win.

answers.name: Rabbit
answers.fact: Fourth. In the Vietnamese zodiac this position is held by the cat instead.

answers.name: Pig
answers.fact: Twelfth and last, said to have overslept on the day of the race.

answers.name: Rooster
answers.fact: Tenth, and the only bird in the cycle.

answers.name: Ox
answers.fact: Second. It led the race almost to the end before the rat jumped off its back.

answers.name: Goat
answers.fact: Eighth, and the hardest to recall. The character means goat or sheep, which is why both are accepted.

distractors.name: Cat
distractors.note: The Vietnamese zodiac has a cat where the Chinese has a rabbit. Correct elsewhere, not here.

distractors.name: Leo
distractors.note: A Western zodiac sign, not a Chinese one.

distractors.name: Taurus
distractors.note: Western zodiac - though it is also a bull.

distractors.name: Phoenix
distractors.note: Appears throughout Chinese mythology, but not in the zodiac.
